talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 94 solo PCPs winding down in Pennsylvania; 13 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Huntingdon Valley 19006, Chester 19013, Pittsburgh 15219) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~10,714 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.
**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (Susquehanna County, Perry County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 16 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~322,800 patients across 269 at-risk practices statewide.
